archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Grand Theft Auto VI: Ampere estimates about 2.1 million US and UK Xbox players used the New Zealand trick for GTA VI

entries.headline: Caladrius 2: Dark Element delayed to January 28, 2027 in Japan; Steam date remains undecided
entries.summary: Moss delayed the Japanese PS5 and Nintendo Switch editions from December 10, 2026 to January 28, 2027. The Steam date is still under adjustment, while the PS5 edition will restrict some Shame Break graphics.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON's full report explicitly relays Moss's announcement. The date is scoped to the Japanese console editions, and the conflicting January 27 wording from another report is not used.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published at 09:00 Beijing time on November 20, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Girls' Frontline: Blue Covenant formally announced for 2027
entries.summary: Sunborn formally announced the cooperative multiplayer PvE shooter Girls' Frontline: Blue Covenant and confirmed the title change from Dolls' Frontline: Blue Covenant. It is planned for release in 2027.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON's full report relays Sunborn's announcement, the official account and the teaser. Only the formal title, cooperative PvE positioning and 2027 window are used; no platform is inferred.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published at 12:33 Beijing time on November 19, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Famitsu Sales (November 9–15, 2026): Ocarina of Time for Switch 2 remains No. 1 in Japan with 86,097 retail copies
entries.summary: Famitsu's estimates for November 9–15 show The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for Switch 2 selling another 86,097 retail copies. Switch 2 hardware sold 42,402 units, while the PS5 family sold 11,136.
entries.verification: Gematsu's full summary of the Famitsu estimates was reviewed. Every figure is scoped to estimated Japanese retail sales and is not extended to digital or worldwide sales.
entries.timeNote: Gematsu updated the report at 21:11 Beijing time on November 19, inside the fixed window; the chart covers November 9–15.

entries.headline: App Store Awards 2026 names 45 finalists
entries.summary: Apple named 45 finalist apps and games across iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Arcade and other categories. Game finalists highlighted in the available report include Dave the Diver, Arknights: Endfield and Crimson Desert Enhanced.
entries.verification: The packet's 4Gamer snapshot was reviewed. Only Apple's announcement, the visible total of 45 and the examples named in the headline are used; the truncated remainder is not reconstructed.
entries.timeNote: 4Gamer published at 15:10 Beijing time on November 19, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves adds DLC fighter Laocorn Gaudeamus
entries.summary: SNK released Laocorn Gaudeamus as a new DLC fighter for Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves and published an anime trailer directed by Masami Obari. The character originated in the 1994 animated film.
entries.verification: The packet's 4Gamer snapshot was reviewed. It explicitly relays SNK's release and trailer announcement; moves and pricing absent from the visible text are not added.
entries.timeNote: 4Gamer published at 18:33 Beijing time on November 19, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: WIXOSS to pause new product releases after its February 2027 expansion
entries.summary: Takara Tomy said WIXOSS will pause new product releases after the expansion scheduled for February 27, 2027. The company also outlined continuing support for official stores, rules inquiries and adjusted events.
entries.verification: The full Denfaminicogamer snapshot and its relay of the official notice were reviewed. The copy distinguishes a pause in new products from an end to all support.
entries.timeNote: Denfaminicogamer published at 16:13 Beijing time on November 19, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Slotbound tops 100,000 copies in three days, with about 30,000 peak concurrent players
entries.summary: Solo developer Optima Arch said the PC game Slotbound sold more than 100,000 copies in its first three days and reached roughly 30,000 peak concurrent players on Steam.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON's full report was reviewed. The figures are explicitly attributed to the developer's November 17 disclosure and are not presented as platform-audited data.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published at 11:00 Beijing time on November 19, inside the fixed window; the developer disclosed the figures on November 17.

entries.headline: Steam Machine 512GB model returns to open sale, with no new waitlist after stock runs out
entries.summary: Valve said existing waitlist orders for the 512GB Steam Machine have been handled and the model can now be bought directly. Once current stock sells out it will show as unavailable rather than open a new waitlist; new 2TB waitlist registrations are also closed.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON's full report was reviewed. The copy uses its explicit account of Valve's inventory notice and preserves the uncertainty around future production and pricing.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published at 09:28 Beijing time on November 20, inside the fixed window. Its Valve announcement date is October 20, so only the article time establishes window placement.

entries.headline: Alinea estimates Slay the Spire 2 has sold 7.9 million copies on Steam
entries.summary: Alinea Analytics estimates Slay the Spire 2 has sold about 7.9 million Steam copies and generated roughly $157.6 million. It also estimates that 25% of players passed 100 hours and about 100,000 buyers have not launched the game.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON's full report and its displayed Alinea Analytics estimates were reviewed. Every sales, revenue and behavior figure is labeled as a third-party estimate rather than official developer or Valve data.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published at 12:08 Beijing time on November 19, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI: Ampere estimates about 2.1 million US and UK Xbox players used the New Zealand trick for GTA VI
entries.summary: Ampere Analysis estimates that about 1.5 million US and 600,000 UK Xbox players changed regions on November 18 to play Grand Theft Auto VI early. The figure does not include a complete PlayStation estimate.
entries.verification: IGN's full report was reviewed. The figures are explicitly attributed to Ampere Analysis and limited to Xbox users in the US and UK; the article's PlayStation speculation is excluded.
entries.timeNote: IGN published at 01:59 Beijing time on November 20, inside the fixed window; the behavior occurred on November 18.
